title: Section multiplicativity from a compatible family
statement: Under the finite structure product hypotheses and a compatible family v : ℕ → (G ⟶ G), Grothendieck existence yields a product map μ : G ⊗ G ⟶ G satisfying the stated section multiplication identity.

proof.text: Apply finite_structure_product_exists_core to the finite-structure data. Its conclusion is exactly the section-multiplicativity conclusion. The extra endomorphism family v and its constancy hypothesis are unnecessary; the core constructs the actual reduced multiplication family independently.
